requested_changes.body:
Would you please  check the CSS for this button? In generating setting a fixed size is not good for responsible screens, which means that it may mess the inline editor in small screens or not.

I also do believe this should be a button just like to GPU button, that do not show additional information because the base image information is always visible at the cell, it looks redundant!

Still about the minWidth. Please notice that the other componens have a relative width which summed give it a 100% result. I would make this a button, set its width as `5%` and change the `Depends on` to have `30%`.

comments.body:
Could we retrieve this information from the backend to keep it aligned between backend and frontend?

You can see how Adam implemented a backend property to retrieve the KFP host information. The same could be done for the base image: https://github.com/kubeflow/kale/pull/520/changes#diff-8d069efbd791d2303d5b2c423b84ae69d18021bd67a288594dfd17ed55cb812dR22

This way we won't have to update in two different places if we want to change the default base image.
Why is this field disabled? I can't change the base image anymore.

Would you please  check the CSS for this button? In generating setting a fixed size is not good for responsible screens, which means that it may mess the inline editor in small screens or not.

I also do believe this should be a button just like to GPU button, that do not show additional information because the base image information is always visible at the cell, it looks redundant!

I would avoid changing style in inline CSS like this because this may be broken if we change the look and feel of the application using the underlying framework. Since you are opening a Dialog Box, I would keep this as a simple button just like the GPU one.

Still about the minWidth. Please notice that the other componens have a relative width which summed give it a 100% result. I would make this a button, set its width as `5%` and change the `Depends on` to have `30%`.
